svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut a 16 x 11 mm square of mesh with fine snips.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Flatten it between two steel blocks; file off any loose wire ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: lay it on the inner floor, centred over the inlet slot (the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: left slot seen from the front); the inlet seal sits on it and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: holds it down. Nothing else fixes it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: it covers the whole slot with 2 mm to spare all round.
